---
title: "Health Behaviours"
subtitle: "Smoking and alcohol consumption patterns"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "docs/assets")
from portal_helpers import load, fig_defaults, kpi_row, data_note, COLORS, blue_ramp
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

data = load("behaviours")

# Smoking intensity, least to most; darker blue = more smoking.
SMOKING = ["Never", "Former", "Current – occasional", "Current – daily"]
SMOKING_COLORS = dict(zip(SMOKING, reversed(blue_ramp(len(SMOKING)))))
SEGMENT_GAP = dict(color="white", width=1.5)  # separates stacked segments
```

Health behaviours such as tobacco use and alcohol consumption are key modifiable risk factors.
This section examines their distribution across the survey population.

---

::: {.section-header}
## Smoking status — overall
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
smoking_df = pd.DataFrame(data["smoking_overall"]).set_index("smoking_status").reindex(SMOKING)

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=smoking_df["pct"],
    y=SMOKING,
    orientation="h",
    marker_color=[SMOKING_COLORS[s] for s in SMOKING],
    text=[f"{p:.1f}%" for p in smoking_df["pct"]],
    textposition="outside",
    cliponaxis=False,
    hovertemplate="%{y}: %{x:.1f}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="% of respondents",
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
    showlegend=False,
)
fig_defaults(fig, "Smoking Status — All Respondents", height=320).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## Smoking by age group
*Current smoking rates tend to decline in older cohorts (cohort effect)*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
by_age_df = pd.DataFrame(data["smoking_by_age"])
age_groups = sorted(by_age_df["age_group"].unique().tolist())
fig = go.Figure()
for status in SMOKING:
    subset = by_age_df[by_age_df["smoking_status"] == status]
    vals   = []
    for ag in age_groups:
        row = subset[subset["age_group"] == ag]
        vals.append(float(row["pct"].values[0]) if len(row) else 0)
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(name=status, x=age_groups, y=vals,
                         marker=dict(color=SMOKING_COLORS[status], line=SEGMENT_GAP)))

fig.update_layout(
    barmode="stack",
    yaxis_title="% of age group",
    xaxis_title="Age group",
)
fig_defaults(fig, "Smoking Status by Age Group", height=430).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## Alcohol consumption frequency
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
alc_df = pd.DataFrame(data["alcohol_overall"])
order  = [
    "Never",
    "Less than once/month",
    "1–3 times/month",
    "1–2 times/week",
    "3+ times/week",
]
alc_df["alcohol_frequency"] = pd.Categorical(alc_df["alcohol_frequency"], categories=order, ordered=True)
alc_df = alc_df.sort_values("alcohol_frequency")

# Frequency is an ordered scale: darker blue = more often.
pal_alc = list(reversed(blue_ramp(len(order))))
fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=alc_df["alcohol_frequency"],
    y=alc_df["pct"],
    marker_color=pal_alc,
    text=[f"{p}%" for p in alc_df["pct"]],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{x}: %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="% of respondents", xaxis_title="Frequency")
fig_defaults(fig, "Alcohol Consumption Frequency", height=380).show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
data_note("Smoking and alcohol questions are subject to self-report bias. Actual consumption rates may differ from reported rates.")
```
